champion.tips: ANNIE TIPS AND TRICKS Look for constant picks with Tibbers R once you’re level 6. Annie’s all-in against squishy champions is incredibly strong. Look for trades around your stun. Pre-level 6, use the stun on your Q rather than W as you’re guaranteed to land the stun if you use your Q . Annie is really good at starting team fights if she can flank the enemy. Running at them is going to be difficult, but you could set up death bushes and wait for the enemy to walk by before throwing out Tibbers R .
champion.builds: THE BEST ANNIE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Annie Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Absolute Focus and Manaflow Band in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Malignance. For your last 3 items, you should build Stormsurge, Shadowflame and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 48.9% winrate over 773 matches played. Optional Your second option for Annie Support build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Malignance as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Liandry's Torment, Zhonya's Hourglass and Vigilant Wardstone. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 53.4% win rate over 279 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Dream Maker as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Malignance as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Liandry's Torment and Morellonomicon. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 56.1% win rate across 82 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Annie Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Arcane Comet, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm as your primary rune tree, and Ultimate Hunter with Taste of Blood as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Malignance as third item. The last 3 options are Liandry's Torment, Rylai's Crystal Scepter and Vigilant Wardstone. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 51.9% win rate over 77 matches played. Situational Annie Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Annie build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Annie runes page.
